seo.description: Reference integration points for display panels, semiconductors, and new energy. This content supports discussion and solution assessment; it is not evidence of validated delivery capability.

hero.title: Industry Scenarios
hero.subtitle: Use three process chains to explore possible tool integration points, validation tasks, and applicability boundaries

panel.problem: Substrate identity and carrier binding break easily; alignment-exposure and colour-filter pattern defects rely on manual re-inspection; Cell/Module anomalies are hard to trace back to a specific step.
panel.hardware: A soft PLC on domestic industrial silicon drives loading, cleaning and lamination takt, with anti-collision interlocks on the robot arms.
panel.vision: openIndu-vision uses OpenCV for surface particles/scratches, pattern breaks and pinholes, and lit-panel appearance judgement.
panel.data: Assess whether openIndu-cim + openIndu-platform can associate Glass ID, carrier ID, process route, and program versions.
panel.craftsmanship: The forum's panel column collects field practice and defect back-tracing for the TFT-LCD / OLED chains.
panel.whyWorks: A target architecture can connect engineering assets, inspection results, and step identity. Cross-brand generation, control-loop latency, and end-to-end traceability still require validation in the target environment.

semiconductor.problem: Wafer identity and route-admission checks are scattered across tools; recipe versions and SPC rules are hard to unify; defect maps cannot effectively drive back-end sorting.
semiconductor.hardware: Domestic industrial silicon handles transport and tool interlocking, gating admission on prerequisites and SPC rules.
semiconductor.vision: openIndu-vision joins appearance and defect re-inspection, emitting coordinates and layer information.
semiconductor.data: Assess openIndu-cim for edge-side processing and openIndu-platform for associating wafer ID, FOUP, recipe versions, and metrology values.
semiconductor.craftsmanship: The forum's semiconductor column records interface conventions and traceability fields for the wafer-to-package chain.
semiconductor.whyWorks: The scenario can verify whether decision data, edge processing, and chamber or lot traceability form a reproducible path.

newEnergy.problem: Material-lot identity is hard to guarantee before mixing; cell identity easily decouples from formation and grading curves; EOL data in the module/PACK stage is incomplete.
newEnergy.hardware: Domestic industrial silicon controls coating, assembly and formation-cabinet takt, coordinating multi-brand equipment.
newEnergy.vision: openIndu-vision inspects electrode alignment, weld spots and module appearance (including PV EL images).
newEnergy.data: Assess whether openIndu-cim + openIndu-platform can associate material lots, cell identity, test curves, PACK, and EOL records.
newEnergy.craftsmanship: The forum's new-energy column records process parameters and anomaly handling for the lithium-battery and PV-module chains.
newEnergy.whyWorks: The scenario helps define validation points for identity continuity and curve association. Lithium-battery and PV workflows must be evaluated separately.

whyEffective.heading: How openIndu Directions Support Scenario Assessment
whyEffective.subheading: The project map helps identify interfaces among vision, control, engineering assets, and data. Actual capability depends on repository status and reproducible evidence.

items.title: Cross-brand engineering asset exploration
items.description: Mappings and intermediate artifacts can reduce repeated entry; every brand, version, and output format still requires validation in the target IDE and hardware environment.

items.title: Vision-control interface assessment
items.description: Use openIndu-vision and openIndu-studio to explore inspection-result interfaces. Control-loop behaviour and latency require target-system tests.

items.title: Parameter delivery and audit
items.description: Use openIndu-platform to explore permissions, versions, effective-time mechanisms, and rollback. Delivery latency must be measured in the target environment.

items.title: Data-path validation
items.description: Map the intended path across equipment, vision, parameters, and process knowledge, then verify each interface. An architecture diagram is not a production data path.

items.title: Process knowledge discussion
items.description: The forum preserves context, constraints, validation steps, and applicability boundaries. Parameters cannot be reused outside their material, equipment, and test conditions.

items.title: Built for engineering collaboration
items.description: Review each repository's status, LICENSE, dependencies, deployment notes, and limitations before adoption or extension.
